- M3 (`2cat<=>cat2`): The activation requires dimerization. At lower total catalyst concentrations, the equilibrium shifts to the left, resulting in a *lower* fraction of active catalyst. The reaction rate will drop by *more* than a factor of 5 (approaching a 25-fold drop) compared to Run 1.

This single experiment will cleanly separate M8 (sub-linear scaling), M3 (super-linear scaling), and the M6/M7 cluster (linear scaling).
